title: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing that its stockholders' equity of $2,260,120 as of December 31, 2025 has fallen below Nasdaq's $2,500,000 minimum stockholders' equity requirement, resulting in a delisting notification. The company intends to request a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel to appeal the determination.
key_points: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. received a delisting notification from Nasdaq on April 20, 2026 due to stockholders' equity of $2,260,120 falling below the $2,500,000 minimum requirement
The company's Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 reported the non-compliant equity figure
The company previously regained compliance in November 2025 but has since fallen out of compliance
The company intends to timely request a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel to stay the delisting action
The company is evaluating available options to regain compliance but there is no assurance of success
The company's common stock trades under symbol NDRA on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC
